Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Media & Communication trainee position at ICF Next in Brussels. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am eager to contribute to your campaigns and grow within a leading agency.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites. I have hands-on experience with social media integration, media monitoring, and reporting using tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush. My project mirook.com involved implementing structured data and optimizing for AI search, demonstrating my ability to adapt to new trends.

I am particularly drawn to ICF Next's work with EU institutions and am keen to apply my storytelling and organizational skills to support PR, social media, and influencer activities. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and have residency in Belgium. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 and improving.

I am proactive, detail-oriented, and enjoy collaborating in teams. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok
